symptom: Pressing Login produces Tip: Invalid or expired gameplay credential before MID1 RETRIEVE_TOKEN.

source_facts.fact: getAbtestGroupByKey sends MID2864 with unique_key only.
Before MID1, token_ and region_ have not been assigned; nil fields are omitted from the JSON payload.
MID1 RETRIEVE_TOKEN is the later login/context selection request carrying sid, login_token, and selected region.
Observed stock startup order includes MID7 -> MID2864 -> MID1.

backend_contradiction: Pass348 AuthScopeRegistry PUBLIC_MIDS omitted 2864 and defaulted all other known MIDs to SELECTED_PLAYER.
PostgresStateRepository.request_scope duplicated the same public set and attempted gameplay-token resolution for MID2864.
Therefore a source-proven pre-MID1 request was forced to present a gameplay credential that cannot exist until MID1 succeeds.
implementation_decision: Treat MID2864 as PUBLIC_BOOTSTRAP compatibility traffic because the stock client emits it before MID1 and the private-server handler is context-free/deterministic (mtspy -> B). This does not assert the official server physical/auth policy.
changes: gxb_backend/state/repository.py: use AuthScopeRegistry.PUBLIC_MIDS instead of duplicated hardcoded set.
gxb_backend/runtime/state_repository.py: use AuthScopeRegistry.PUBLIC_MIDS instead of duplicated hardcoded set.

local_assets/src_32/app/common/network/Backend.lua and src_64 counterpart: include GET_PLAYER_GROUP_BY_KEY in context-bootstrap bypass so the Pass340 client fence does not suppress this source-proven pre-MID1 lookup.

No JSON fallback or dual authority.
